title: Exploring the landscape of compact magic-state distillation factories
summary: Producing high-fidelity magic states using the smallest possible number of physical qubits and operations stands as a very important challenge to achieve fault-tolerant quantum computation at scale. Besides emerging proposals for alternative methods such as cultivation, magic state distillation remains essential for achieving very low error rates. Known distillation protocols are usually built through quantum codes derived from triorthogonal matrices.
